title: PAD PROMPTS NAME THE BUTTONS AS SET
why: Found in the cloud hunt of 2026-10-15: v26.53 promised every raid prompt names the new button after CHANGE PAD BUTTONS, but six still typed the default name: the backpack cue and NO HEAL ON BELT said VIEW, the belt said RT TO DRAW, the pickup line said LB or RB to swap, and the ring prompt said [Y] SEARCH. Proven in headless Chromium: with the backpack moved to Y the cue still said VIEW  BACKPACK while VIEW no longer opened it and Y did; with fire on A the belt still said RT TO DRAW. Each now asks pbn() for the button the action is on; the default layout reads exactly as before.
now: With the controller buttons changed, the raid prompts name the buttons you set.

edits.anchor: if(findHeal()>=0){ say('NO HEAL ON BELT','info',{sub:(padOn()?padB('VIEW  BACKPACK'):('['+keyLabel('KeyB','B')+'] BACKPACK'))}); return false; }
edits.replacement: if(findHeal()>=0){ say('NO HEAL ON BELT','info',{sub:(padOn()?padB(pbn(8)+'  BACKPACK'):('['+keyLabel('KeyB','B')+'] BACKPACK'))}); return false; }  // v16.xx (cloud-menus-pad-prompts-follow-binds), CLOUD HUNT 2026-10-15: the NO HEAL ON BELT line named VIEW for the backpack after CHANGE PAD BUTTONS moved it; it names the button the backpack is on
